title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. Announce Recall of Motocross Motorcycles
summary: The rear brakes on these motorcycles can fail, causing a rider to lose control of the vehicle and crash, resulting in injuries or death. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, BBC International Ltd. Announce Recall of Crayola® Toddler Boots
summary: The toggle, a small plastic ball attached to the laces, can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 38,000.

title: CPSC, Black and Decker Inc. Announce Recall to Repair 12-inch Miter Saws
summary: Bolts on the saws can loosen and the blade could detach, posing a risk of lacerations to consumers. Units: About 6,400.

title: CPSC, DEWALT® Industrial Tool Co. Announce Recall to Repair 12-inch Miter Saws
summary: Bolts on the saws can loosen and the blade could detach, posing a risk of lacerations to consumers. Units: About 112,000.

title: CPSC, Trane Company Announce Recall of Voyager Heating and Air Conditioning Systems
summary: One of the three internal flue gas tubes extending from the heat exchanger can separate from the heat exchanger. This could allow flue gases, including carbon monoxide, to enter the building airstream. This could result in serious injury or death to building occupants. Units: 967.

title: Lamps Recalled by Environmental Lighting Concepts
summary: An electronic component inside the plug can overheat, presenting a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,560.

title: Rope Lights Recalled by CO2UCH
summary: The rope light controller, which allows consumers to choose the type of light motion, such as flash or chase, can short circuit. This poses shock, fire, and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 27,300.

title: Tree Wound and Grafting Compound Recalled by the Tanglefoot Co.
summary: Pressure can build inside the can and forcibly discharge the compound, which can cause temporary skin irritation. Units: About 35,000.

title: CPSC, Playskool Announce Recall to Replace Certain "Busy School Bus" Toys
summary: On certain units, the yellow "awning" piece above the bus' door can break loose, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 12,500.

title: CPSC Recommends Carbon Monoxide Alarm for Every Home
summary: Under certain conditions, fuel-burning appliances can produce deadly CO. However, with proper installation and maintenance, they are safe to use. Units: .

title: CPSC, Trends Clothing Corp. Announce Recall of Girls' Sweatshirts
summary: These sweatshirts have hood drawstrings. Children can get entangled and strangle in the drawstrings that catch on objects, including playground equipment, fences and tree branches. Units: About 6,600.

title: CPSC and Designer Classics LLC Announce Recall of Children's Jeans and Overalls
summary: The small decorative metal appliques on the legs of the garments can come loose and separate, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 11,000.

title: CPSC, Central Sprinkler Company Announce Voluntary Recall To Replace O-Ring Fire Sprinklers
summary: These sprinkler heads can corrode or minerals, salts and other contaminants in water can affect the rubber O-ring seals. These factors could cause the sprinkler heads not to activate in a fire. Units: 35 million.

title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Bicycles and Bicycle Components
summary: The recumbent bicycle's front fork steering tube can break, the frame of the 12-inch children's bicycle can break during use, the Cannondale bicycle forks can break, the Magura brakes could fail, the Supergo handlebars can crack and break, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall and s

title: CPSC, Kenyon International Inc. Announce Recall of Portable Butane Stoves
summary: The unit's safety fuel shut-off system could fail to shut off when the fuel container is overheated. If overheated, the flame from the stove flares up, and cannot be controlled with the adjustment valve, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,500.

title: CPSC, Kole Imports Announce Recall of Contact Adhesive
summary: The adhesive contains toluene, which can present a fire and poisoning hazard to consumers. The packaging of this product does not have the required cautionary labeling, as required under the Federal Hazardous Substances Act. Units: About 90,000.

title: CPSC, Carter's® Announce Recall to Repair Infant Jumpsuits
summary: A ribbon that runs through the zipper pull tab can detach, resulting in a potential choking hazard. Units: About 600,000.

title: CPSC, Seattle Bike Supply Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
summary: Because the bikes' pedals are too low to the ground, they fail to meet federal bicycle standards. Children can lose control when a pedal strikes the ground, causing falls and injuries. Units: About 1,400.
